 Follow Amal Clooney brings back the ultimate suede jacket for fall during stylish night out with George Clooney
 Daniel Neira Fri, November 6, 2026 at 5:31 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Amal Clooney brings back the ultimate suede jacket for fall during stylish night out with George Clooney (Taylor Hill) Amal Clooney is making a case for one of fall's most timeless wardrobe staples. The human rights lawyer stepped out in New York City alongside her husband, George Clooney , wearing an effortlessly chic ensemble that combined vintage fashion, luxurious textures and understated glamour.

 The couple attended a special reading of the stage play Smear at Seaview Studio on November 1, with Amal embracing autumn dressing in a camel-colored suede coat that brought a retro-inspired touch to her sophisticated look.
 The stylish couple attended a special reading of the stage play Smear at Seaview Studio on November 1, 2026. (@ Instar Images/The Grosby Group)
 The statement piece, reportedly a vintage Gucci design from the fashion house's Spring/Summer 2015 collection, featured a structured collar, oversized gold-tone buttons, a tailored silhouette and a thigh-length hem.
 The warm brown shade offered a stylish alternative to traditional black outerwear, while the coat's vintage appeal added another layer of interest to her ensemble.
 Amal's vintage-inspired fall ensemble featured warm neutral tones, gold-tone buttons and timeless suede, making it an effortless source of autumn fashion inspiration. (@ Instar Images/The Grosby Group)
 Amal paired the suede design with a cream-colored minidress and sleek black over-the-knee boots, creating an elegant contrast between soft neutrals and darker accessories. She completed the outfit with a small black handbag and delicate gold earrings.
 Advertisement Advertisement For her beauty look, the lawyer wore her signature brunette hair in voluminous waves, complemented by defined eyes, rosy cheeks and a soft pink lip.
 Amal Clooney makes a case for vintage suede this fall
 Suede has long been associated with autumn fashion, and Amal's latest appearance demonstrates why the material remains a favorite for seasonal dressing.
 Amal Clooney stepped out in New York City wearing a chic camel-colored suede jacket, proving that classic outerwear never goes out of style. (@ INSTAR Images LLC)
 Her camel-colored coat brought texture and warmth to an otherwise minimalist ensemble, proving that a statement outerwear piece can elevate even the simplest wardrobe essentials.
 The Gucci design dates back to the brand's Spring/Summer 2015 collection and is a piece Amal previously wore in 2015. By bringing the jacket back into her wardrobe more than a decade later, Amal demonstrated the lasting appeal of investing in classic fashion pieces that transcend seasonal trends.
 The human rights lawyer paired her vintage Gucci jacket with a cream-colored minidress, black over-the-knee boots and a sleek black handbag. (@ INSTAR Images LLC)
 Rather than opting for an elaborate outfit, she kept the rest of her look understated, allowing the rich texture of the suede and the coat's tailored construction to take center stage.
 Advertisement Advertisement The combination of camel, cream, and black also offered a versatile color palette that can easily be recreated with classic fall staples.
 A stylish night out with George Clooney
 Amal was joined by George, who complemented her sophisticated outfit in a dark navy suit worn over a matching dark shirt and finished with black shoes.
 Amal and George Clooney shared a sweet kiss during their night out in New York City. (@ INSTAR Images LLC)
 The actor participated in the one-night charity reading of Smear , a play written by Clark Gregg, alongside a cast that included Betty Gilpin, Laverne Cox and Adam Scott.
 Following the event, the couple were photographed leaving the venue together, with Amal smiling for cameras and greeting people gathered outside.
 Amal Clooney showed off her signature voluminous brunette waves and glowing makeup as she smiled and waved to photographers. (@ INSTAR Images LLC)
 In another sweet moment captured during the outing, Amal and George shared a kiss before departing.
 Advertisement Advertisement While George opted for his signature understated tailoring, Amal brought a vintage-inspired fashion statement to their night out, proving that some wardrobe staples only get better with time.
